text.tspan: When you don't know the probability of rise or fall,
And you can't choose any OPTIONS to PUT or CALL.
Then take a RANDOM WALK to a BINOMIAL TREE,
And watch BULLS, BEARS, BUTTERFLIES SPREAD free.
OPEN, STOP, FILL OR KILL at any TIME OF THE DAY,
On LIMITS and ORDERS, IN, AT or OUT of the pay.
SWAP FLOATING with FIXED when times are a brisk,
If you want to avoid unprecedented short term risk.
You can STRIP the STRAP, STRADDLE and STRANGLE,
To COMBINE multiple OPTIONS, that together tangle.
COVER the NAKED, when VOLATILITY IMPLIED is high,
If you don't want to end up with a distressing sigh.
P MEASURES the future and Q MEASURES a benchmark,
And between them you can desire everything, even dark.
Always BACK TEST models to FACTOR LOAD and SCORE,
And use those insights to KNOCK, UP and DOWN the door.
